question: Which industrial region in India is historically renowned for its dominance in the cotton textile industry and is often referred to as the "Manchester of India"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad-Vadodara Industrial Region**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Ahmedabad-Vadodara Industrial Region** in Gujarat is historically referred to as the "Manchester of India" due to its dominance in the cotton textile industry.
 
• Ahmedabad became a hub for the cotton textile industry in India during the 19th century, benefiting from proximity to raw materials (cotton), cheap labor, and accessible transport networks.
 
• The region's dry climate and access to the Sabarmati River for water supply made it ideal for cotton processing and manufacturing.
 
• Ahmedabad houses some of the oldest textile mills in India and has been instrumental in shaping the country’s textile sector.
 
• The rise of the textile industry in this region contributed significantly to India's economic growth during the colonial and post-independence periods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chota Nagpur Industrial Region**
 
 
• This region is known as the "Ruhr of India" due to its rich reserves of minerals such as coal, iron ore, and manganese.
 
• It is a major hub for the iron and steel industry, with key centers like Jamshedpur (Tata Steel), Bokaro, and Rourkela.
 
• The region also hosts industries related to heavy machinery, cement, and chemicals.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai-Pune Industrial Region**
 
 
• One of the most developed industrial regions in India, it is known for its diverse industries such as textiles, automobiles, engineering, and IT.
 
• Mumbai, often called the "Gateway of India," was historically famous for its cotton textile mills.
 
• Today, the region has evolved into a center for electronics, pharmaceuticals, and financial services.
 
 
 
• **Hugli Industrial Region**
 
 
• This industrial belt is centered around Kolkata and extends along the Hugli River.
 
• It is known for jute industries, with Kolkata being the world's largest jute manufacturing center.
 
• Other industries in this region include paper, textiles, engineering, and chemicals.
